name: finpilot
description: FinPilot — say or type an expense; AI turns it into a validated ledger entry (Cloudflare Workers + D1 + React + Claude)

scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply finpilot --local && wrangler dev
scripts.setup: npm install && cd client && npm install
scripts.build: cd client && npm install && npm run build
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply finpilot --remote && wrangler deploy
